bad-ux-by-companies-as-an-effort-to-push.content:
Googling the filmography of any actor would give you a list of their movies and TV shows arranged in a grid with movie/show poster and the name underneath. Google completely scraped that and instead focuses on showing "AI Overview" which is fucking annoying because I don't want a generic AI answer with the extra useless text and showing like five movies in a short AI answer instead of just letting me browse the entire list of an actor's filmography like I preferred.
Fucking hate it when platforms do stupid this, ruining the UX only to push their new favourite child into everyone's face.
